ownerSearch.result: Extended the existing BalconyACSet. No second condenser/trunking owner created. Recursive tree contained no named penetration/putty owner.

periodScope: Unbranded around-2000 Japanese residential balcony interpretation. 6.35/9.52 mm tube ODs, cover/sleeve sizes and materials are modern/common modeling references only, not a claim about a particular historical SKU.

assets.manufacture: Assumed annealed copper refrigerant tubing with closed-cell elastomer insulation, hollow hexagonal flare nuts and short anti-chafe boots.
assets.mounting: Connects existing condenser service-stub ends to the existing trunking lower service opening. Authored route is a diagnostic assembly route, not a pressure-rated fabrication drawing.
assets.interfaces: Copper remains geometric through the route. Insulation is a real hollow sleeve starting after the visible flare region; flare nuts have a real bore. Review endpoints stop 0.5 mm before existing trunking insulated stubs to avoid coincident surfaces.
assets.orientationExposure: Service-side run rises gently toward wall cover; exposed copper/flare region is rain/splash exposed, insulated run is partly sheltered.
assets.aging: No green copper oxidation, oil stain or artificial wet highlight baked. Roughness and subtle deterministic micro-normal only.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Copper, insulation wall thickness, flare-nut shell and transition boots are geometry. Fine copper/foam grain is PBR microdetail.

assets.manufacture: Assumed injection-molded exterior PVC snap-cover elbow with hollow wall and a separate lower snap-joint band.
assets.mounting: Installed at the top of the existing vertical trunking; review assembly uses 2 mm intentional covered overlap under the joint band.
assets.interfaces: True hollow curved rectangular shell. End section enters the wall-sleeve volume; it is not a solid bent box or painted opening.
assets.orientationExposure: Vertical-to-wall 90 degree turn; outer crown sun/rain exposed, wall-side underside sheltered.
assets.aging: Warm ivory base only. No arbitrary yellow streaks; UV chalking/dirt remains placement-specific.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Hollow shell, end annuli and snap band are geometry; PVC micrograin is PBR material detail.

assets.manufacture: Assumed PVC wall sleeve, hand-applied non-hardening exterior sealing putty and thin EPDM interface lip. Putty perimeter is deliberately irregular rather than a perfect torus.
assets.mounting: Centered on the wall penetration. Review wall is 140 mm diagnostic concrete thickness; sleeve and putty straddle its exterior plane.
assets.interfaces: Sleeve is a true hollow tube. Putty is a closed irregular annular solid with a large central opening for the service-cover end; EPDM lip is a separate annular shell.
assets.orientationExposure: Exterior putty face exposed to sun/rain and service handling; sleeve interior sheltered.
assets.aging: No cracking, mold or water streaking asserted. Slight warm-gray putty and rough microstructure only until scene-specific aging is authored.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Sleeve bore, putty annulus and EPDM lip are geometry. Fine putty/PVC/rubber texture is material microdetail.
